svg.title: Finish register — three model base colours
svg.desc: Three samples cropped from the actual Stillform demonstration model textures: dark fumed oak with lateral grain, ivory linen with a woven pattern, and ink blue velvet. For each, the outlined area is enlarged in the adjacent detail strip. Base-colour crops are not physical samples, measured colours or predictions of reflectance.
svg.text: BASE COLOUR · FROM THE DEMO MODEL
